test_autograd_backward: test the gtn library backward pass by computing gradients on scalar graph addition and subtraction operations
test_forward_score_grad: test forward score gradient computation on a GTN graph with numerical gradient verification
test_viterbi_score_grad: test viterbi score gradient computation on a GTN graph with multiple start and accept nodes
test_viterbi_path_grad: test viterbi path gradient computation on a GTN graph and verify gradients match expected arc weights
test_numerical_grad_check: test numerical gradient checking by perturbing graph arc weights and comparing analytical gradients to finite differences
